title: Refusing a cigarette commercial
summary: A cigarette company wanted a piece; he refused.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Studio work and jingles: New York session life

blocks.x: What every band wanted then was a cigarette commercial.
Some cigarette. I remember one time they wanted to use one of the focus pieces and they wanted to pay a thousand dollars or some-
thing outright and they would have the perpetuity. But for cigarettes, I don't want to help poison the nation. This was before the surgeon general's report and they didn't like that at all.
That may be why I'm not working too. I don't really feel badly about that; I would like a decent income, but I wonder how it would be to sell that junk all the time.
Think of having to write the advertising copy for it; that is even worse. At least from the musical standpoint you're just supplying a melody or something.
But as much as in movies, it effects what you're thinking. I would do it if I had the opportunity, I never turned down the chance.
